response.justification: Bogdan possesses strong engineering experience and highly relevant domain expertise in geospatial data processing (GISCollective) as well as low-latency distributed systems. However, his recent professional experience is heavily focused on TypeScript/Node.js, and his systems programming background is primarily in DLang rather than the strictly required Modern C++ or Rust.
strengths: Strong domain expertise in geospatial data processing and mapping platforms (Founder of GISCollective).
Solid background in building low-latency, high-throughput distributed microservices handling millions of requests.
Demonstrated full-stack capabilities with a strong emphasis on software craftsmanship, TDD, and rigorous QA.
concerns: Lacks recent or extensive experience in Modern C++ or Rust, which are the primary technologies required for the role.
Recent professional roles are heavily focused on web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than systems-level data pipelines.
No direct experience mentioned with routing algorithms, navigation guidance solutions, or real-time traffic integration.
